mapper.sql: P.PRGRM_SN, P.PRGRM_TYPE_CD, CASE P.PRGRM_TYPE_CD WHEN 'EXPLORE' THEN '사건탐구' WHEN 'MISSION' THEN '미션' ELSE P.PRGRM_TYPE_CD END AS PRGRM_TYPE_NM, P.PRGRM_NM, P.TRGT_CN, P.TOTAL_TM_MNT, P.MAX_NOPE, P.SIMPLE_EXPLN, P.START_EXPLN, P.USE_YN, P.TEAM_CNT, P.ROUTE_JSON, P.STEP_JSON, P.EVAL_JSON, P.REG_DT, P.RGTR_NM, P.MDFCN_DT, P.MDFR_NM, P.DEL_DT, P.DLTR_NM
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EDU_PRGRM_MST ( PRGRM_TYPE_CD, PRGRM_NM, TRGT_CN, TOTAL_TM_MNT, MAX_NOPE, SIMPLE_EXPLN, START_EXPLN, USE_YN, TEAM_CNT, ROUTE_JSON, STEP_JSON, EVAL_JSON, RGTR_NM, REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{prgrmTypeCd}, #{prgrmNm}, #{trgtCn}, #{totalTmMnt}, #{maxNope}, #{simpleExpln}, #{startExpln}, #{useYn}, #{teamCnt}, #{routeJson}, #{stepJson}, #{evalJson}, #{rgtr}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE EDU_PRGRM_MST SET PRGRM_NM = #{prgrmNm}, TRGT_CN = #{trgtCn}, TOTAL_TM_MNT = #{totalTmMnt}, MAX_NOPE = #{maxNope}, SIMPLE_EXPLN = #{simpleExpln}, START_EXPLN = #{startExpln}, USE_YN = #{useYn}, TEAM_CNT = #{teamCnt}, ROUTE_JSON = #{routeJson}, STEP_JSON = #{stepJson}, EVAL_JSON = #{evalJson}, MDFR_NM = #{mdtr}, MDFCN_DT = NOW() WHERE PRGRM_SN = #{prgrmSn} AND PRGRM_TYPE_CD = #{prgrmTypeCd} AND DEL_DT IS NULL
